passwd_file.description: Path to the s3fs password file containing AWS credentials.

bucket.description: Name of the S3 bucket to mount, optionally followed by a path (e.g., bucket:/path).

mountpoint.description: Local directory path where the S3 bucket will be mounted.

endpoint.description: AWS region endpoint for signature version 4 authentication.

default_acl.description: Default canned ACL for uploaded objects (e.g., private, public-read).

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed S3 transaction.

use_cache.description: Local folder to use for file caching. Empty string disables caching.

storage_class.description: S3 storage class for objects (e.g., standard, standard_ia, reduced_redundancy).

use_sse.description: Server-side encryption setting (1 for SSE-S3, kmsid:<key> for KMS, custom:<path> for SSE-C).

parallel_count.description: Number of parallel requests for uploading large objects.

multipart_size.description: Part size in MB for multipart uploads.

multipart_threshold.description: Threshold in MB to switch to multipart upload.

max_stat_cache_size.description: Maximum number of entries in the stat cache.

stat_cache_expire.description: Expiry time in seconds for stat cache entries.

umask.description: Umask for files under the mountpoint.

allow_other.description: Boolean to enable allow_other FUSE option for multi-user access.

logfile.description: Path to a log file. Empty string uses syslog/stderr.

dbglevel.description: Debug message level (crit, err, warn, info).

iam_role.description: IAM role name for EC2 instance authentication, or 'auto'.

requester_pays.description: Boolean to enable Requester Pays mode.

no_check_certificate.description: Boolean to disable SSL certificate verification.

use_path_request_style.description: Boolean to use legacy path-style request URLs.

streamupload.description: Boolean to enable experimental stream upload.

max_thread_count.description: Maximum number of threads for stream uploads.

ensure_diskfree.description: MB of disk space to ensure free in the cache directory.

free_space_ratio.description: Min free space ratio (0-100) of the disk.

sigv4.description: Boolean to enforce AWS Signature Version 4.
